integrity: The proof reduces every Birkhoff-orthogonal unit pair to two one-variable branches, proves the positive branch dominates, and certifies its unique interior maximizer by an exact constrained derivative resultant plus Sturm root isolation. Decimal evaluation is not used as proof. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact computation is for the real two-dimensional space \(\ell_4^2\) only. The maximizing parameter is given as an isolated algebraic root rather than by radicals; no higher-dimensional value or complete isometry-orbit classification is asserted.
title: Exact Ahmad--Xie--Li \(T_{\perp}\) constant of the real \(\ell_4^2\) plane
